# implicit-sdf.library: DistanceToCapsule

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The signed distance from a point to a capsule: the segment from a to b
> thickened by radius. Exact, and the general form of DistanceToVerticalCapsule.
> (IQ: sdCapsule.)

## Signature

```plato
DistanceToCapsule(p: Point3D, a: Point3D, b: Point3D, radius: Number): Number
DistanceToCapsule(p: Point2D, a: Point2D, b: Point2D, radius: Number): Number
```

## Laws

These are declared laws. Whether each one passes is recorded by the law runner ([stdlib/VERIFICATION.md](../../../../../stdlib/VERIFICATION.md)), not by this page.

### Law_DegenerateCapsuleIsSphere

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 38](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L38)

```plato
// A capsule whose two endpoints coincide at the origin is a sphere. Cross-checks
// the segment-based capsule against the closed-form sphere.
Law_DegenerateCapsuleIsSphere(p: Point3D, radius: Number): Boolean
    => DistanceToCapsule(p, Point3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), Point3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), radius)
        .LawEq(DistanceToSphere(p, radius));
```

### Law_DegenerateCapsule2DIsCircle

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 43](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L43)

```plato
// A planar capsule with coincident endpoints is a circle.
Law_DegenerateCapsule2DIsCircle(p: Point2D, radius: Number): Boolean
    => DistanceToCapsule(p, Point2D(0.0, 0.0), Point2D(0.0, 0.0), radius)
        .LawEq(DistanceToCircle(p, radius));
```

### Law_VerticalCapsuleIsCapsuleAlongY

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 49](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L49)

```plato
// The vertical capsule is the general capsule running from the origin along Y.
// Two independently written bodies that must agree everywhere.
Law_VerticalCapsuleIsCapsuleAlongY(p: Point3D, height: Number, radius: Number): Boolean
    => DistanceToVerticalCapsule(p, height, radius)
        .LawEq(DistanceToCapsule(p, Point3D(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), Point3D(0.0, height, 0.0), radius));
```

### Law_CollinearTriangleIsSegmentDistance

[stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato, line 322](../../../../../stdlib/tests/implicit-sdf.laws.plato#L322)

```plato
// A collinear triangle has no interior, so its field must be the unsigned
// distance to the segment it collapsed onto — never negative. The law that
// catches the sign test calling a degenerate triangle inside.
Law_CollinearTriangleIsSegmentDistance(p: Point2D, a: Point2D, b: Point2D): Boolean
    => DistanceToTriangle(p, a, a, b).LawEq(DistanceToCapsule(p, a, b, 0.0));
```
